written.headline: Sakana AI CEO says Sawara model targets industry and security needs
written.summary: Japanese startup Sakana AI is developing a homegrown foundation model named Sawara to support local industry, manufacturing, and national security applications. Co-founder and CEO David Ha stated that the project aims to address limitations and biases in foreign AI models while meeting domestic demands for on-premises deployment.

written.headline: Nasscom report says AI may shrink traditional IT and call centre markets
written.summary: A Nasscom research report states that artificial intelligence could shrink traditional markets for software maintenance, infrastructure services, and call centres. At the same time, the report notes that AI may create new growth opportunities by lowering software development costs and expanding access to smaller businesses.
